title: Yes-only anytime-goalscorer markets are never priced: a one-sided market has no fair price and is dropped
steps: Synthetic event, one book posts only {Yes +150} for player_goal_scorer_anytime / any Yes market (typical US-book shape: no No side)
expected: Either a clear consensus-only price or an explicit 'no fair price' state for the Yes side.
actual: Consensus needs books quoting both sides, so a Yes-only market gets books=0, fair=NaN, ev=NaN, and filterFeed drops it (no_fair). The No row has no price (no_price). Nothing is shown. Anytime scorer is the most common soccer prop and many books list Yes only, so coverage may be much thinner than the Props tab implies.
evidence: PSOC-script.ts: 'Fake Striker goal scorer anytime: Yes bk=0 fair=NaN ev=NaN'
